description: Speaks a friendly greeting the moment NVDA is ready to use - a time-of-day message (good morning, afternoon, or evening) by default, or your own custom messages. Add several messages and a different one is chosen each time NVDA starts. Fully configurable from NVDA Settings, and adds a matching message on your braille display too.
changelog:
= 2026.09.09 =
- Initial release.
- Speaks automatically as soon as NVDA finishes starting, with no key press required.
- Default greeting is time-of-day aware (good morning, afternoon, or evening).
- Add your own custom messages instead of the default greeting; if you add more than one, a different one is spoken each time NVDA starts.
- Adds an "NVDA Startup Greeter" category to NVDA Settings to enable/disable the greeting or manage your custom messages.
- Also shows a matching message on a connected braille display.
